description: Four manual voltage sources, each a knob running from -5V to +5V, with an on/off switch on the first two

params.text: Sets the voltage on that output: -5V at fully counter-clockwise, 0V at the centre, +5V at fully clockwise
Switched up, the VOLTAGE 1 knob reaches OUT 1; switched down, OUT 1 is held at 0V
Switched up, the VOLTAGE 2 knob reaches OUT 2; switched down, OUT 2 is held at 0V

outputs.text: Carries the VOLTAGE 1 setting while ON 1 is up, and 0V while it is down
Carries the VOLTAGE 2 setting while ON 2 is up, and 0V while it is down

notes: this module has no inputs at all; every output is set by hand from the panel.
both ON switches come up in the up position, so all four outputs carry their knob settings when the module is first placed.
